demo: prefer the installed release over a source build on PATH (#5570)

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

perf(dev): reduce build work and isolate BDD dependencies (#5559)

* perf(dev): avoid eager helper builds and unchanged CLI rebuilds

Build the contributor CLI before dispatch and leave existing helper/payload preparation to first use. Remove the missing root build-script watch without weakening source identity tracking. Cover the wrapper and watch roots with regression tests.

* perf(build): isolate optimized AES-GCM and trim Foundation features

Keep concrete AES-GCM instantiations in an internal opt-level-2 leaf instead of optimizing all of mvm-core. Preserve keys, framing, nonce ownership, session checks, and wire compatibility in their existing owners. Use shared Cargo codegen defaults and narrow Foundation to the APIs actually used.

* perf(test): compile Cucumber only for explicit BDD runs

Make the framework optional under the existing bdd feature and move its World support out of automatic integration-target discovery. Preserve all actual tests and explicit BDD coverage, update closure accounting, and record measured compilation and artifact-reuse results with their limitations.

* refactor(crypto): group primitives in a shared crypto crate

Rename mvm-aead to mvm-crypto and place the unchanged AES-GCM operations in its aead module. Keep one optimized crypto compilation boundary rather than a crate per algorithm. Update consumers, manifests, regression checks, and documentation; retain historical benchmark labels.

* feat(crypto): expose an extensible authenticated-encryption trait

Define the public Aead contract with algorithm-specific key, nonce, and error types and support static or trait-object dispatch. Implement it for stateless AES-256-GCM while retaining its concrete optimized code in mvm-crypto. Keep existing protocols explicitly on AES-256-GCM, preserve compatibility checks, and test downstream implementations with different associated types.

* chore(ci): account for crypto interface and regression coverage

Re-measure the complete tracked Rust tree at 991437 SLOC and 1259775 physical lines. The requested crypto trait and compile/dependency regression coverage add 259 SLOC and 313 physical lines above the prior exact limits. Keep every category counted and grant no extra headroom; the gate and all three footprint tests pass.

* fix(fuzz): lock the shared crypto dependency in detached workspaces

Refresh all seven standalone fuzz graphs that depend on mvm-core. Only add the internal mvm-crypto node and reroute the AES-GCM edge; preserve every third-party version and dependency edge. All nine fuzz workspaces pass cargo check --locked --all-targets on macOS.

* fix(dev): prepare native helpers before dispatching the CLI

The live smoke exposed that launch commands deliberately cannot compile missing helpers. Preserve that restriction by building the CLI and native host helpers in a single Cargo graph, without embedding the Linux builder payload. Keep the contributor feature set and pair isolation; update the regression test and correct the CLI-only documentation.

* ci: refresh PR checks after resolving release conflicts
